definitions.m_full: mean of soft margins on the image's own Full generate tokens
definitions.m_fastv: mean of soft margins on the image's own FastV generate tokens at r
definitions.Delta: D(B) - D(noise) on the same sample and r
definitions.delta_positive_means: B opens a larger Full-versus-FastV margin gap than the paired noise at the same budget; it is not strict success
definitions.prefixes: Full and FastV each follow their own greedy tokens
definitions.strict_remeasured: analyze_v7.strict_of predicate: anls_full>=0.5, anls_fast<0.5, pred_full equals frozen clean_full_pred, output_valid on both new texts, published replay_ok, 0<published linf<=8/255, frozen clean full and fastv anls>=0.5. ANLS is metrics_task.anls_score on this run's texts. replay and linf are read from the published PNG records and are not recomputed.
definitions.strict_curve_for_decision: remeasured B strict rates at the four budgets from this run's generate texts

bootstrap.interval: percentile 2.5 and 97.5 of the resampled mean

definitions.sign_test: exact two-sided binomial sign test on non-zero paired sweet-minus-outer differences; zeros are excluded
definitions.shards: sorted integer sample ids, shard i receives ids[i::4]
